ranking_basis: Evidence quality and project fit, not a weighted quality score; ranks are review priority only.

candidates.research_problem: Specific industrial anomaly appearance from 1-3 real examples when all adaptation supervision is bbox/image-level, particularly tiny low-occupancy anomalies.
candidates.why_it_matters: Weak labels can mix anomaly and background; a specific defect concept is not synonymous with a whole-object prompt.
candidates.what_prior_art_does: AnoGen supplies bbox synthesis and a non-mask training ablation; MURA supplies positional low-contrast generation with hundreds of patches; AnomalyAny needs no anomaly training.
candidates.what_remains_unsolved: The reviewed evidence does not establish that a literature-distinct limitation exists under the combined strict shot/weak-label setting, nor certify tiny-defect fidelity.
candidates.why_Plastic_Bomo_can_test_it: Frozen TRAIN boxes can define adaptation access without historical edits. Current project metadata does not provide independent pixel truth.

minimum_experiment_needed.description: If separately requested: compare existing AnoGen non-mask and its mask-supervised control on an external mask-annotated dataset with masks hidden from the weak arm; fix shot budget and raw output count, obtain independent held-out assessment. Plastic_Bomo only after a non-circular endpoint is available. No method proposed.
minimum_experiment_needed.decision: Reject candidate if existing weak baseline suffices or supposed failure is only ambiguity of evaluation labels.

candidates.overlap_with_BootstrapGuard: No overlap only if the question is adaptation information, not output ranking/filtering.
candidates.novelty_risk: HIGH: AnoGen already contains the nearest weak-supervision ablation; absence of an end-to-end claim is not proof of a new method gap.
candidates.reason_not_primary: Closest ablation already tests the lost mask signal; this audit cannot distinguish an open methodological gap from already available baseline performance.

candidates.research_problem: Independent generated-label validity for tiny/weak/elongated defects, where input condition or predicted mask cannot act as truth.
candidates.why_it_matters: A training pair can be structurally well-formed yet have geometry that does not describe visible anomaly content.
candidates.what_prior_art_does: SeaS and DualAnoDiff derive masks from generated features/parts; DefectSimu refines with SAM; SynSur reports scratch-segmentation failures and a condition-mask fallback.
candidates.what_remains_unsolved: A sufficiently precise unfiltered weak-supervision setting not already covered by content-derived masks or annotation quality control is NOT established.
candidates.why_Plastic_Bomo_can_test_it: Only a separately approved independent diagnostic assessment of new generated samples could test it. Current box conditions/derived masks do not resolve it.

minimum_experiment_needed.description: If separately requested: assess existing content-derived and condition-derived labels with blinded independent judgments on public tiny/scratch examples; first test whether label-disagreement is systematic and reproducible. No teacher-guided optimization, image quality Top-K or module implementation.
minimum_experiment_needed.decision: Reject if existing content-derived labels suffice, if judgments are ambiguous, or if the question reduces to the stopped controllability route.

candidates.overlap_with_BootstrapGuard: Any quality filter/teacher selector would overlap and is excluded.
candidates.novelty_risk: VERY_HIGH: image-mask alignment is an explicit prior-art target. Could simply rebrand Stage23B or turn into a selection method.
candidates.reason_not_primary: Known remedies and explicit failure reports exist, but a new problem boundary and non-circular project endpoint have not been established.
